# learnbot-mcp

AI chatbot orchestrator - persona management, conversation lifecycle, safety guardrails, multi-platform output (speech, opencode).

## Tools

- `persona_create`, `persona_get`, `persona_list`, `persona_delete` - persona CRUD
- `chat_start`, `chat_send`, `chat_hibernate`, `chat_resume`, `chat_destroy`, `chat_list` - conversation lifecycle
- `safety_rule_create`, `safety_rule_list`, `safety_rule_delete` - safety guardrails
- `audit_query` - conversation audit log
- `platform_send` - platform bridge (speech, etc.)

## Ports

- Backend: 11101 (REST API) + stdio (MCP)
- Frontend: 11102 (Vite dev)

See `llms-full.txt` for full reference.
